input.manifest_identity: SHA-256 of exact frozen Unit 1 contract bytes; no directory discovery.
input.encoding: Original byte stream and XML encoding semantics; no lossy caller decoding.

values.names: Exact namespace URI and local name; preserve observed QName/prefix separately.
values.attributes: Enumerate all attributes, including unknown attributes and namespace declarations.
values.xml_mandated_normalization: Preserve parser values; original bytes preserve lexical EOL/entity/quote spelling.
values.content_segmentation: Coalesce adjacent Text/Whitespace/SignificantWhitespace events as text. Preserve each CDATA section, comment and PI node separately. Accumulate value chunks within one reader node; never coalesce across CDATA, child, comment or PI boundaries.

failure_policy: Explicit failed verification/build; no repaired XML, dropped fields or partial-success authoritative output.
resource_limits: Not frozen in Unit 2. Future parser must declare evidence-backed size, character and depth limits; benchmark limits are not production constants.
physical_locations: Optional diagnostic line/column only; no mandatory byte/UTF-16 mapper.
